old_str: in the year to June 2026, 10,021 of 12,468 Bangladeshi student visa applications were granted, against 2,362 of 3,785 work visa applications and 17,568 of 37,254 visitor visa applications [OK0146, OK0147, OK0149].
new_str: in the year to June 2026 Bangladeshis made 12,468 student visa applications, against 3,785 work visa and 37,254 visitor visa applications, and 86% of that year's student visa decisions were grants, against 60% for work visas and 45% for visitor visas [OK0146, OK0147, OK0149].
problem: '10,021 of 12,468 applications were granted' presents grants as a subset of the same year's applications.
